About the Role

We are hiring a Network Security Engineer to implement and deliver enterprise networking and security solutions for enterprise, government, or BFSI projects. The role requires strong multi-vendor expertise and experience delivering projects from design through deployment, migration, testing, and handover.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and implement enterprise networking and security solutions.
• Deliver end-to-end projects, including design, deployment, migration, testing, and handover.
• Work with Cisco, Aruba, Huawei, Palo Alto, and Fortinet platforms.
• Perform network and firewall migrations.
• Troubleshoot complex issues in live production environments.
• Support enterprise, government, and BFSI projects.

Requirements
• Minimum 5 years of hands-on implementation experience in enterprise networking and security.
• Experience in an IT systems integrator environment is preferred.
• Proven end-to-end delivery experience on enterprise, government, or BFSI projects.
• Strong hands-on, multi-vendor experience with Cisco, Aruba, Huawei, Palo Alto, and Fortinet.
• Experience with network and firewall migrations and complex production troubleshooting.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a related field.
• At least one valid expert- or senior professional-level certification is mandatory.

Mandatory Certifications:
• CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
• CCIE Security
• Palo Alto PCNSE
• Fortinet NSE 7 / FCSS
• Equivalent certifications such as Check Point CCSE, Aruba ACEP, or ACX

At least one valid expert- or senior professional-level certification is mandatory.

Preferred Certifications:
• CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Security is a strong advantage.
• CCNP Enterprise / Security or other professional-level certifications are an advantage.

Job Summary

Responsible for operating, maintaining, and supporting the organization's network infrastructure to ensure reliable connectivity, availability, and performance. The role includes troubleshooting network issues, implementing approved changes, and supporting network improvement projects.

Key Responsibilities
• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot routers, switches, and wireless access points.
• Monitor network performance and availability, investigate incidents, and escalate complex issues when necessary.
• Configure and support VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, and routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP.
• Support LAN, WAN, and wireless network connectivity.
• Implement network security configurations, including access control lists (ACLs), in accordance with approved policies.
• Perform approved network changes and software upgrades, including implementation, validation, and rollback procedures.
• Resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service level agreements (SLAs).
• Maintain network diagrams, configuration backups, technical documentation, and asset records.
• Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and service providers to resolve connectivity issues and support project delivery.

Qualifications and Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
• 1–3 years of practical experience in network operations or support.
• CCNP (preferred).
• Practical knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, OSPF, and BGP.
• Understanding of DHCP, DNS, NAT, and VPN technologies.
• Familiarity with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools such as SolarWinds and Wireshark.
• Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and teamwork skills.
• Good command of English for technical documentation and professional communication.

Preferred Qualifications
• Basic knowledge of firewalls and network security.
• Familiarity with SD-WAN technologies.
• Exposure to network automation using Python or Ansible.
• Willingness to participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support as required.

Required Certification:
• Valid Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

About the role OT Cybersecurity Engineer Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Experience: 8 Years

Domain: Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), Industrial Cybersecurity

Employment Type: To be confirmed

Job Overview DWT Technology is seeking an experienced OT Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen security across Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and industrial network environments.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in OT/ICS security, industrial network protection, security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response. The role involves implementing OT cybersecurity controls, assessing risks across industrial assets, supporting compliance initiatives, and collaborating with IT, engineering, and operations teams to protect critical industrial infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities • Secure and monitor OT/ICS environments and industrial networks.

• Implement OT cybersecurity controls, network segmentation, and security monitoring.

• Conduct vulnerability assessments and risk assessments across OT assets.

• Support compliance with IEC 62443, NIST, ISO 27001, and relevant OT security best practices.

• Work with industrial systems and technologies, including SCADA, DCS, PLC, HMI, and industrial communication protocols.

• Develop and maintain OT incident response procedures and security documentation.

• Collaborate with IT, engineering, and operations teams to address OT cybersecurity risks.

• Support security architecture reviews, audits, and compliance initiatives.

• Identify security gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen industrial cybersecurity.

Required Skills and Qualifications • Minimum 8 years of relevant cybersecurity experience.

• Strong knowledge of OT/ICS security and industrial network environments.

• Experience working with SCADA, DCS, PLC, and HMI systems.

• Understanding of industrial network security, segmentation, and OT security monitoring.

• Experience conducting vulnerability assessments and risk assessments across OT assets.

• Knowledge of IEC 62443, NIST, ISO 27001, and OT security best practices.

• Familiarity with SIEM, vulnerability management, and incident response.

• Understanding of industrial communication protocols and OT security requirements.

• Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to support security architecture, audits, and compliance activities.

How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hafiz@dwttechnology.com .
